integrity_check: python -c "import hashlib, pathlib, json; m=json.load(open('MANIFEST.json')); [print(f'{f}: {"OK" if hashlib.md5(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==info["md5"] else "MISMATCH"}') for f,info in m['files'].items() if 'md5' in info]"
